title: Reproducibility code and data for structural kinetic analysis of hepatic polyamine metabolism
description: Python code, three BioModels SBML inputs, and derived numerical data supporting structural-kinetic, substrate-gain, MAT-capacity/throughput control, continuation, robustness, asymptotic substrate-saturation, compatibility-space spectral, native meal-cycle, and regulatory-bistability analyses of hepatic polyamine metabolism. This archive is a reproducibility object only and does not contain the article manuscript or supplementary material.
notes: Release v1.0.1 consolidates the post-v1.0.0 manuscript audits: compatibility-space spectral projection near the high-SAM tail, reduced-cusp nondegeneracy, root-specific numerical spread of the simple-pole boundary, and the native physiological meal-cycle control. It also corrects the sign notation of B1 in the validation text. Manuscript and supplementary article files are intentionally excluded. BioModels SBML inputs are CC0; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
